name: Soft Landing
invitation: A gold circle sits down the clearing. A block and a bank start off to the side. The shot can change, and so can those two pieces.
physicalQuestion: Can a landing be made easier to repeat?
validationEvidence: The tested shot is the opening arrangement and the opening aim. Headless Havok through scripts/range/run.mjs reproduces that first-ground terminal. The shot misses. It is the arrangement a player enters. Measured clears stay in the range appendix and are not stored here.
knownLimitations: One ground plane. Pieces cannot change height, scale, or ramp angle. Aim controls step by half a degree, and power by one percent. A landing that exists only between those steps is not a route the controls can sit on.
